motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, Section 239(2) (c) a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the municipality or local board.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, Section 239(2) (c) a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the municipality or local board.

motions.text: That the Mayor and City Clerk be directed to execute the Agreement of Purchase and Sale for the acquisition of property, as included in the Acquisition of Property for New Paramedic Station closed report dated March 20th, 2024.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Mayor and City Clerk be directed to execute the Agreement of Purchase and Sale for the acquisition of property, as included in the Acquisition of Property for New Paramedic Station closed report dated March 20th, 2024.

motions.text: That the Recommendation Report - Development Fee Review be approved effective April 1,2024 as included in Attachment 2. That the development Applications Fee By-law be amended to reflect the changes in Attachment 2.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Recommendation Report - Development Fee Review be approved effective April 1,2024 as included in Attachment 2.
  2. That the development Applications Fee By-law be amended to reflect the changes in Attachment 2.

motions.text: That the Demolition Control Discussion Paper, as included in Attachment-1, be received. That By-law (2024)-20923, as shown in Attachment-2 of Report 2024-124, being a by-law to designate the entirety of the City of Guelph as a demolition control area, be approved.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Demolition Control Discussion Paper, as included in Attachment-1, be received.
  2. That By-law (2024)-20923, as shown in Attachment-2 of Report 2024-124, being a by-law to designate the entirety of the City of Guelph as a demolition control area, be approved.

motions.text: That by-laws (2024) - 20908, (2024) - 20919, (2024) - 20923, (2024) - 20928 and (2024) - 20929 be approved as amended and subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.
motions.text_html: That by-laws (2024) - 20908, (2024) - 20919, (2024) - 20923, (2024) - 20928 and (2024) - 20929 be approved as amended and subject to Section 284.11 (4) of the Municipal Act.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned. (11:57 a.m.)
